messages:
emily: Quick sync 1 - uploaded a new benchmark storyboard (two hero options + raw CSV). Need alignment on hero metric, one-line PLG copy, and enterprise gating flow.

noah: Saw it. For PLG hero: median (128 tokens) looks best for perceived responsiveness. For enterprise hero callout use p95 with SLA language.

dana: Charts: PLG landing = single hero stat + small cost badge. Blog = latency CDF + cost-vs-latency scatter (annotate recommended configs). Avoid stacked bars.

owen: Agree on CDF. Also propose a tiny interactive slider for sequence length so engineers can see where batching/kv cache helps.

mike: Lead routing rules: form fields = email, company, headcount bracket, expected_monthly_tokens bracket, use_case, private_deploy boolean, need_SLA boolean. If headcount > 100 OR expected_monthly_tokens > 15M OR private_deploy=true -> tag Enterprise and route to AE.

emily: Good. We'll gate the whitepaper behind the form and offer CSV download after email confirm. Keep public blog wording conservative: "up to 1.7x lower per-token cost on short chat sequences; see paper for test harness and configs."

noah: Copy variants: PLG headline = "Fast responses, predictable cost". Enterprise headline = "Deterministic performance for production LLMs". CTAs: PLG = Try API, Enterprise = Request demo / Whitepaper.

dana: Visual accessibility: use colorblind-safe palette and include labels/patterns not just color. Also include alt text for charts.

owen: For analytics: add events bench_whitepaper_download, webinar_register, bench_try_click. Hook them to marketing dashboard and AE notifications for enterprise-fit leads.

mike: I'll build the HubSpot form + automation: create contact + company, score, tag, webhook to AE Slack channel for enterprise-fit. Also add UTM capture.

emily: Webinar idea: 40min tech walkthrough + 20min Q&A: "Production tradeoffs: latency vs cost when serving LLMs." Offer the whitepaper as gated follow-up.

noah: Small legal note: always include baseline model & infra footnote in the blog and whitepaper. Avoid absolute claims without context.

dana: I'll mock hero + blog panels (CDF + scatter) and a small methodology card for the blog. Expect drafts tomorrow.

owen: I'll prototype the interactive slider widget and list the CSV API requirements (CORS, formats).

mike: ETA for HubSpot flow and webhook: 48 hours after comps are final.

emily: Thanks all. Decision summary: PLG hero = median(128), Enterprise hero = p95, gated whitepaper, lead rules as above, add analytics events, webinar planned 2 weeks post-publish. I'll consolidate into the doc and assign next steps. :rocket:
